latestVersion.changelog:
automation-workflows 0.1.0 initial release:

- Launches comprehensive playbook for solopreneurs to design and implement no-code automation workflows.
- Covers identifying automation opportunities, workflow design principles, tool selection (Zapier, Make, n8n), and best practices for testing.
- Includes maintenance and troubleshooting guidance to ensure reliability.
- Provides ready-made workflow templates and advanced automation ideas.
- Triggers include common phrases like "automation," "workflows," "save time," and "no-code automation."

raw_record.summary: Design and implement automation workflows to save time and scale operations as a solopreneur. Use when identifying repetitive tasks to automate, building workflows across tools, setting up triggers and actions, or optimizing existing automations. Covers automation opportunity identification, workflow design, tool selection (Zapier, Make, n8n), testing, and maintenance. Trigger on "automate", "automation", "workflow automation", "save time", "reduce manual work", "automate my business", "no-code automation".
